```artifact
Feature: Patient Management and Workflow

  Scenario: Query on Patient Id and Modify Details
    Given a patient with ID "P001" and pin-code "1234"
    When I query for patient ID "P001"
    Then the patient details should be displayed
    And I should be able to modify the patient details
    And the patient pin-code should not be modified to be outside the Zone

  Scenario: Query on Patient Id and Enter Details
    Given a patient with ID "P002"
    When I query for patient ID "P002"
    Then the patient details should be displayed
    And I should be able to enter details like Speciality, Symptoms, Consultation request, Appointment date
    And if the Appointment Request is for next day, an entry should be created in the Patient Appointment file

  Scenario: Doctor Sees Consultation Requests
    Given a doctor
    When the doctor sees all the workflow consultation requests
    Then the doctor should be able to select and provide Consultation for each request

  Scenario: Doctor Enters Diagnosis and Prescribes Medicines
    Given a doctor and a consultation request
    When the doctor enters Diagnosis and Prescribes medicines (max 8)
    Then the doctor should be able to request for lab tests (optional, max 5)
    And the consultation request should be marked as completed

  Scenario: Chemist Sees Consultation Requests
    Given a chemist
    When the chemist sees all the workflow consultation requests
    Then the chemist should be able to select and provide Medicines for each request

  Scenario: Chemist Dispenses Medicines
    Given a chemist and a prescription
    When the chemist dispenses medicines
    Then the prescription should be marked as dispensed

  Scenario: Lab Sees Consultation Requests
    Given a lab
    When the lab sees all the workflow consultation requests
    Then the lab should be able to select and note down the Lab Requests for each request

  Scenario: Lab Notes Lab Tests and Adds Report
    Given a lab and a prescription
    When the lab notes the lab tests to be done and the Patient details
    Then the prescription should be marked as completed and the report should be added

  Scenario Outline: Negative Test Cases for Pin-Code Zone Constraint
    Given a patient with ID "P003" and pin-code "<pin_code>"
    When I query for patient ID "P003"
    Then the patient details should be displayed
    And I should not be able to modify the patient pin-code to be outside the Zone
    Examples:
      | pin_code |
      | 1234     |
      | 5678     |
      | 9012     |

  Scenario Outline: Boundary Tests for Medicine Count (max 8)
    Given a doctor and a consultation request
    When the doctor enters Diagnosis and Prescribes medicines (max 8)
    Then the consultation request should be marked as completed
    Examples:
      | medicine_count |
      | 0              |
      | 1              |
      | 4              |
      | 8              |
      | 9              |

  Scenario Outline: Boundary Tests for Lab Test Count (max 5)
    Given a lab and a prescription
    When the lab notes the lab tests to be done (max 5)
    Then the prescription should be marked as completed
    Examples:
      | lab_test_count |
      | 0              |
      | 1              |
      | 3              |
      | 5              |
      | 6              |
```
